activities.title: Match the thing with what it does.
Listen. What has everyone got? Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Valentina: Backpack check! Erik, what have you got? … Erik: I've got three pencils, a green ruler and my robot notebook. … Valentina: Sofia has got new scissors with orange handles. … Erik: Mateo has got a pencil case shaped like a fish! … Valentina: And he's lost his rubber again — the third one this month. … Erik: I've got glue, crayons and a sharpener that collects the bits. … Valentina: An invention? … Erik: Of course! Nothing falls on the floor. Teacher-approved!
